tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tse'u dmar sku phebs skabs phul ba// dpal phrin las kyi mgon po chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu gang de'i snyan drung du/ zhu ba/ da lam ngos skabs 'dir lcags byi snron zla'i nyer gcig mus chen rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi dus mchod thog 'byor 'phral nas rang bzhin lhan skyes thog mar chos skyong chen po dpon blon gyi lcog la bcar 'dod bcos min dang / nam 'gor dgyes bskyed gtor bsngo bskang ba rgyas bsdus ji 'dra byung song yang lhag bsam 'don cha dmigs rim phra mo dang / tshig rjes sems 'brangs tsam zhus thog spre'u zla ba'i dus chen nyer lngar srol bzhin lcog steng lha bsangs/ de nas sems bskyed gling du 'byon srol nged rang tsho'i phyis byon gdung brgyud bla ma phal cher gyi rnam thar na 'dug pa bzhin zhus nas/ las ldan sku g.yar la zhal gzigs shugs drag chen pos yus nyams lha lcog nas myur stabs kyis gshegs pa'i rgyal sgo'i phyi rol du ye shes lnga ldan lha dar skyes su stsal zhing / gzhan yang go babs rab dkar lha gos kyi gnang cha'i thog rdo skas rtse nas gdung re rer phyag 'dren gyis gzengs bstod/ nged rang nas sngon gyi thugs dam bskul ba gus gsan gyis lha tshes gsum thog bgyi ba gang dgos zhal sangs gnang ba dang / der ma zad zla 5tshes 27tho rengs rmi lam ngang nas lcog tu mjal bar zhi nyams chen po'i gsungs las/ 'dir lcog ru bca' sgrigs tshang ma'i yon tan rten de la dgyes nyams chen pos 'di phye mar gyis bkang gsung ba dang / lcog rgyal sgo'i phyi nas dngos sum gyi khri lcog nang la bltas pa'i bkod pa gnang 'dug pa 'di ni phyi rten phyi btsugs nas nor gyi god kha sel ba/ nang rten nang du btsugs nas bang mdzod srung ba gsang rten gsang bar bcas nas las mkhan gyi srog gta' mar bzung ba gsungs pa de zur rten du bdag gi rmi lam rang du go byung ba bzhin lha tshes gnyis la phyi rten btsugs gsum la nang gsang rten dgus dad spro gsum gyis 'dzugs pa lags na gu ru rin po che nyid snyigs dus 'gro 'dul gang yin de'i rnam par phebs nas bstan 'gror sna tshogs thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pas phan bde spel bar gsungs pa bzhin byang phyogs thub pa'i rgyal tshab rje btsun blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dpal bzang por zhabs brtan sgrub dgos gang yin gsal ba zhu//

༈ /mtshal gung drag shugs dbang por phul ba/ kye/ rtsal drag ldan pa'i sku gsung thugs kyis ni/ /shugs can las bzhi skad cig nyer bsgrubs nas/ /snyigs dus rgyal ba'i bstan spel dmu rgod 'dul/ /de sogs ngo mtshar dpal 'dzin bstan srung cher/ /dang por rgyal sras rigs bkra 'od gsal lha/ /bar du phyi nang gsang ba'i srin 'khon gdung / /mtha' mar sa 'dzin skya bor rgyal ba'i zhing / /mngon sum sprul 'dra'i gnas las mtshan gsum ldan/ /gang gi rigs chos 'dzin par rnam dkar las/ /mthu smon dus 'dir dkon mchog thugs rjes grub/ /rgyud bzhi'i rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' blo/ /gzhon nu skal ldan dbang dang e yi ming / /bsnyen pa du ma mthar phyin 'chi med ma/ /da nas gdung 'di'i dpal ster dpal ming can/ /thabs shes rig 'dzin rnams nas snyan sgron par/ /lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad/ /zhes sogs rang rang skad du chos ston par/ /kun tu bzang po'i thugs smon las gsungs bzhin/ /lha yi gzugs dang klu dang gnod sbyin gzugs/ /grul bum dag dang mi yi gzugs rnams dang / /'gro ba kun gyi gzugs rnams ji tsam par/ /thams cad gzugs su bdag gis don byed do/ /zhes sogs dri med lung gis ngos bzung ltar/ /lnga bdo'i mthar thug dbus 'dre sa mthar 'khyams/ /mtha' 'dre dbus slebs mi rnams mi dge spyod/ /nad mug mtshon gyis ngan song gnas 'drar byed/ /de tshe gdug pa 'dul phyir dregs byed kyi/ /ded dpon mchog tu sangs rgyas phrin las shar/ /tshar gcod rjes 'dzin mdzad pa'i mthu stobs can/ /khyed ni bsam zhing srid bzung nyid lags na/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing dang pad+ma 'od/ /nyer bzhi'i yul dang so gnyis gnas kun dang / /'jigs rung dur khrod brgyad sogs nyul nas ni/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras zhi khro rab 'byams lha/ /mkhas grub ji snyed drung du srog gi snying / /mdongs gsol phul nas spyi bor rdo rje bzhes/

/ljags la a mṛta yi ro myangs pa'i/ /dam tshig gnyer gtad drag po da dgongs shig /thub pa'i bstan pa ris med grub mtha'i srol/ /gdul bya'i skal bar mkhas grub de des bkral/ /de lta'i ring lugs rang rang bzhed srol bzhin/ /phyogs dus kun tu spel zhig sa ma ya/ /ma rig las nyon sdig sgrib las byung ba'i/ /snod bcud ma rung mi dger sbyor 'di rnams/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag gang 'dul des thul zhig /dge 'bras sems can 'phral yun bde skyid kun/ /'jig rten khams 'di kun gyi legs 'grub nas/ /mngon mtho nges legs dpal la sbyar du gsol/ /rig 'dzin rnams la legs nyes blang dor rnams/ /gsal bar ston la gang bcol phrin las kun/ /myur du mdzod cig stobs ldan drag shugs dbang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dam tshig rjes dran mdzod/ /rnam lnga mdog can sgron dar gser phud dang / /rab dkar cod paṇa rnam bzhi 'bul lags na/ /de bzhin dge ba'i grogs dan yang dag mdzod// ༈ /tshal gung du bse khrab par 'bul rgyu/ hrīḥ che btsan drag po bse go can la sogs/ /mtshan gyi rnam grangs can gyi chos skyong cher/ /'dzam gling mtshan gsum nyi zla ltar grags gdung / /skyed byed de myug de nas 'byung 'gyur gyi/ /thabs shes dam ldan rnams nas gsol 'di dgongs/ /sngon tshe rgyal dang mkhas grub bka' 'dzin pa'i/ /dregs byed khyed nas bstan 'gro'i bde skyid spel/ /'dir 'dus nged rnams blang dor lung bstan gsol/ /re 'bras ji bzhin sgrub pa'i dus la babs/ /de skad gsol rten gser phud sgron dar sna/ /zhi mdangs kha btags bzhi bcas sa skya pa/ /blo dbang e dang 'chi med ming 'dzin dang / /gzungs ma dpal ming can nas 'bul gyis bzhes// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ tsi'u dmar sku phebs skabs phul ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
